messages.content: I am looking for movie recommendations. I have some specific requirements that I would like to discuss, so I hope you can help me navigate through them systematically.
I can help with that. Do you care more about tone, genre, recency, or who you will watch it with?

I would say tone is most important to me. I prefer something thoughtful and character-driven rather than purely action-oriented. Genre matters as well — I am drawn to science fiction or drama, though I remain open. Recency is less critical.
That helps. Any constraints I should avoid, such as bleak endings, long runtimes, or intense violence?

I prefer to avoid excessively bleak endings — I appreciate melancholy or bittersweet conclusions, but not nihilistic ones. Runtime is flexible within reason, though I do have limited patience for films exceeding two and a half hours. Intense violence is not necessary; I find psychological depth more compelling than graphic content.
Based on what you told me, I recommend Arrival first.
